positive_snippets: Flexibay is the perfect mix of hostel comfort and hotel luxury! Loved the flexible stay options — I booked just for 2 nights but ended up extending for a week. Super clean rooms and friendly staff

Amazing experience at Flexibay! It feels like a hotel but has the homely vibe of a hostel. The flexible check-in and check-out policy made my trip so much easier. Highly recommended for solo travellers
“A perfect blend of comfort, affordability, and flexibility. The vibe here is great — peaceful yet social. Flexibay really stands out from regular hostels!”
negative_snippets:
I had a very bad experience at this hotel. The service was extremely poor, and the staff behaved very rudely. The service boy misbehaved and spoke in a very unprofessional and disrespectful manner.

There was no washroom in the room, which was very inconvenient. Overall, the behavior of the staff was unacceptable.

I personally do not recommend this hotel. Please avoid it.
